I am a young woman farming a small sorghum plot here in Amhara. My plot is only 0.06 hectares, very small, so I cannot afford much fertilizer from the cooperative, but I will try to get a little DAP if the supply comes on time. I keep a few animals, so I will spread manure on the plot like my family has always done, and I will use seed I saved from last harvest because improved sorghum seed is hard to find and expensive. I do not have irrigation — I depend on the meher rains — and I will do most of the weeding and work myself with help from my household.
